about: Luminé Kennels was founded on a simple belief: every puppy deserves the best possible start in life. We pour immense care into each litter — from nutrition and socialisation to health screening and matching puppies with their perfect families.
hero_title: Where Every Puppy Finds Their Family
hero_desc: At Luminé Kennels, we raise SACBR-registered dachshunds and KUSA-registered English bulldogs with love, care, and the highest breeding standards.
